title: SICP: o fim de uma era
summary: A short Portuguese-language excerpt of Gerald Sussman's 2016 NYC Lisp Meetup talk explaining why MIT replaced the Scheme-based 6.001 (SICP) course with Python courses. The full talk is linked in the description.
why: HN uses it as the canonical explanation from Sussman himself of why SICP ended at MIT.

quote.text: we can't mention SICP without referencing this (relatively recent) video
